targeted_abuse.definition: Insults, degradation or harassment directed at a person or group. Distinguish criticism of an idea, familiar banter, reporting and counterspeech; use uncertain when context is missing.

identity_attack.definition: Attacks, dehumanization or denial of rights based on identity. Identity mentions or discussion of discrimination alone are not attacks. Mark ambiguous quotation or missing context uncertain.

threat.definition: Threats or encouragement of physical harm. Distinguish reporting, condemnation, fiction and idiom. Do not infer a real-world capability or legal conclusion.

sexual_explicit.definition: Explicit sexual description, requests or sexual harassment. Record whether content is present, not whether a community should allow educational or medical discussion; the serving policy is separate.

explicit_nudity.definition: Visible explicit nudity. Do not infer nudity under clothing. Mark obscured or ambiguous content uncertain. Artwork and medical context require separate context notes; do not infer age, consent or legality.

sexual_activity.definition: Visibly depicted sexual activity, rather than merely suggestive posing or text implying an act. Use uncertain when the image alone is insufficient. Do not infer age, consent or legality.

suggestive_clothing.definition: Visible underwear, swimwear or comparably revealing clothing. This is descriptive, not automatically an unsafe-content decision. Do not infer intent, morality or personal characteristics.

contextual_sexual_harm.definition: Sexual harassment or harmful sexual meaning requiring image text or context, beyond explicit nudity. Record context and uncertainty; a nudity classifier does not establish this label.

instructions: Use only supplied content and context. Keep uncertainty explicit. Human review must be declared honestly; model-assisted labels are not independent human validation. Do not place model scores or previous dataset labels in blinded review inputs. Source grouping and training independence require a separate audit.
